name: Transport for Switzerland
freeEvidence: Operator offers its public transport API for developers to build applications using open Swiss timetable data. Anonymous documented GET locations needs query; fields projection limits this response. No fixed client limit; cache station data and avoid repeatedly asking the same question every few seconds. Preserve opentransportdata.swiss source and underlying data attribution.

name: StatCan Statistics
freeEvidence: Official Statistics Canada WDS API exposes public aggregate statistics without registration. Open Licence FAQ permits sharing, redistribution and sale without fees, with Statistics Canada attribution and third-party exclusions. This bounded GET returns the download URL for population table 17100005; it does not fetch the large archive.

name: Brazilian Chamber of Deputies Open Data
freeEvidence: Official FAQ explicitly states data is completely free, no registration/identification is required, and services using the data may charge without restriction. Official API documents party collection pagination; this reads one public political-party record, not personal information.

name: Czech National Bank
freeEvidence: Official CNB documents machine-readable exchange-rate files. Website terms permit storage, distribution and reproduction of bank-owned information, excluding authored third-party works/images. Credit Source: the CNB, preserve the original text and rate meaning, avoid logo/endorsement. One public daily pipe-separated rate table is returned unchanged.

name: Istanbul (İBB) Open Data
freeEvidence: Official Istanbul Open Data Licence permits copying, publication, distribution, adaptation and commercial/non-commercial use without special permission; preserve source attribution, non-endorsement and personal/third-party rights exclusions. This public CKAN metadata GET projects one small record, not its resource downloads.

name: Transport for Grenoble, France
freeEvidence: Official SMMAG MData API page states data use is free subject to ODbL. Reads one Grenoble tram-line geometry. Preserve SMMAG attribution and ODbL notice; redistribution/derived databases must preserve applicable ODbL rights and share-alike requirements. Official current app documentation and operator-hosted ODbL text reviewed.

name: Chicago Data Portal API
freeEvidence: City offers data as a public service and its Use of Data terms expressly contemplate secondary/derivative software applications. This keyless GET retrieves one public catalog metadata object. Preserve City source, no-warranty/own-risk disclaimer and agency-specific restrictions; do not imply official endorsement. Underlying datasets can have additional terms and are not blanket-licensed by this recipe.

name: LA Open Data API
freeEvidence: Official Los Angeles Open Data terms apply to application developers and grant users access, use, reproduction and distribution through portal functionality. One keyless public catalog metadata record is returned. Preserve provider/source and no-warranty conditions; comply with any agency/dataset-specific terms and avoid collecting private personal information.

name: Norwegian Central Bank
freeEvidence: Official Norges Bank publishes this REST API as open data. Copyright policy permits electronic/paper copies with Norges Bank attribution, no content alteration, no framing or promotional linking. Reads one latest USD/NOK observation in documented CSV format, unchanged; no registration/key or paid feed.

name: Bundesbank API
freeEvidence: Official Bundesbank REST API documents this time-series key and bounded observation query. ESCB reuse policy covers publicly released ECB/national-central-bank statistics: free access/reuse for commercial and non-commercial purposes, quote Source: Deutsche Bundesbank statistics, do not modify statistics/metadata and preserve third-party exclusions.

name: Data.gouv.fr
freeEvidence: Official DINUM publishes the complete dataset/API/resource catalog metadata under Licence Ouverte 2.0. Public paginated read is anonymous; API keys apply to writes. This reads one catalog record. Preserve data.gouv.fr/publisher attribution and update metadata; underlying resources retain their individual licences.

name: Fed Treasury
freeEvidence: Official Fiscal Data API documentation states data is offered free, without restriction, for copying, adaptation, redistribution and commercial/non-commercial use. Anonymous GET and page[size] are documented. This reads one Treasury exchange-rate record, not another Treasury authentication-gated API.

name: Open Government, Luxembourg
freeEvidence: Operator explicitly documents its free and open API; authentication/API keys are required for write operations, not public reads. One catalog metadata record is requested. Preserve each metadata/resource licence, prefer CC0 as recommended in official publishing guidance, and do not assume the separate LETZDATA catalogue terms grant rights to this portal.

name: Open Government, New South Wales
freeEvidence: Official Data.NSW exposes public CKAN metadata/data APIs and documents open collections with Creative Commons Attribution. This small metadata query is explicitly restricted to records with license_id=cc-by; it does not grant rights to NC/ND or restricted records. Preserve dataset/publisher attribution and individual licence details.

name: Open Government, West Australia
freeEvidence: Official Data WA publishes anonymous CKAN catalog API. Reviewed hello query returns one metadata record explicitly under Creative Commons Attribution (cc-by), such as Mining Tenements DMIRS-003. This relies on the record-specific open licence, not the general data.wa.gov.au website copyright policy which restricts commercial reuse. Preserve publisher/source and individual licence requirements.

name: Open Government, Victoria State Government
freeEvidence: Official DataVic documentation expressly supports third-party applications through CKAN API. Website material is CC BY 4.0 except images/branding and third-party content. Reads one small public catalog metadata record. Attribute State Government of Victoria and originating agency; individual underlying datasets/historical versions may have additional terms.

name: Austrian Central Bank
freeEvidence: Official OeNB quick guide documents keyless XML content/data web service for automated statistical retrieval. ESCB reuse policy grants free access/reuse of publicly released national-central-bank statistics for commercial/non-commercial purposes. Attribute Oesterreichische Nationalbank statistics, preserve metadata unchanged and third-party exclusions. This retrieves the small topic hierarchy, not bulk series.

name: Portuguese Central Bank
freeEvidence: Official Banco de Portugal BPstat API documentation describes public domains/data API. ESCB reuse policy grants free commercial/non-commercial reuse of published national-central-bank statistics, with source attribution, unchanged metadata and third-party exclusions. This anonymous GET reads exchange-rate-domain metadata only; no banking account or reporting API is involved.

name: Peruvian Central Bank
freeEvidence: Official BCRPData API supports direct GET without logging in. Conditions allow full/partial reproduction without express authorization when the source is cited. Attribute Banco Central de Reserva del Peru and preserve source qualifications. Retrieves one real September 2016 observation from a documented historical CPI series; no empty future period is used.

name: Digitraffic Finland
freeEvidence: Official Fintraffic open traffic data licence is CC BY 4.0 and explicitly permits commercial reuse. Preserve Source: Fintraffic / digitraffic.fi, license CC 4.0 BY, copyright/version and no-warranty information. Public train-type metadata GET requires gzip; reviewed shared transport bounds compressed and decoded bodies. No key or account.
